content: 1. Epinephrine and trimethoprim both prolong the QTc interval. Therapy should be modified or closely monitored. 2. Racemic epinephrine and trimethoprim both prolong the QTc interval. Therapy should be modified or closely monitored. 3. Trimethoprim and eplerenone both increase serum potassium levels. Use caution and monitor closely. 4. Trimethoprim reduces urinary potassium excretion, which may lead to hyperkalemia, especially at high doses, in renal insufficiency, or when combined with other hyperkalemia-inducing drugs. 5. Trimethoprim and eprosartan both increase serum potassium levels. Use caution and monitor closely. 6. Erdafitinib increases trimethoprim levels by reducing renal clearance. Therapy should be modified or closely monitored. Consider alternatives that are not OCT2 substrates or reduce the dose of OCT2 substrates based on tolerability. 7.
